name: Paying Your Debts
overview: Scripture teaches that paying debts is a matter of righteousness and integrity, warning against borrowing without the intention to repay as the wicked do, while the righteous show mercy and give generously (Psalms 37:21). Proverbs cautions believers to avoid becoming sureties for others' debts and highlights the servitude that comes with borrowing (Proverbs 22:7, 22:26). Ecclesiastes emphasizes the importance of fulfilling vows, declaring it better not to vow than to vow and fail to pay (Ecclesiastes 5:5). Additionally, Christians are called to render what is owed to others with honor and to support the weak, reflecting the blessing of giving over receiving as taught by the Lord Jesus (Romans 13:7; Acts 20:35).
